name: Pulsed_Output_SSHI
rationale: The best previous design (SSHI_FullBridge) failed marginally on ripple (S3) and settling (S4). This is a classic trade-off: increasing C_out reduces ripple but increases settling time. To break this, I am adding a second stage of energy transfer. The first stage is the standard SSHI flipping and a full-bridge rectifier that charges a buffer capacitor (C_mid). The second stage uses a synchronous switch (S2) to transfer charge from C_mid to C_out in controlled pulses. This creates a second-order filtering effect and allows the tuner to optimize the energy delivery rate independently of the storage capacitance, which should simultaneously reduce ripple and improve settling stability.
